hypothesis: A captured Android MotionEvent callback could begin under a prior captured listener, then finish after ReleaseCapture followed by a new RequestCapture. Only checking requested=true in RecordCapturedMotion was insufficient and could inject stale deltas into the new camera.

exact_source_change.source_guard: Each RequestCapture increments epoch, constructs a distinct CapturedListener carrying that generation, and installs that listener on Android View. Every MOVE prefilters token against current epoch and requested; RecordCapturedMotion checks same token again while holding captureGate before moving any delta. Old listener can never forward motion from a previous generation.
